storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Every word and action embodies loyalty, every move reflects virtue.

Although "knowing propriety and righteousness, being strict with oneself" is deeply engraved in the soul, this virtuous knight undoubtedly still bears the appearance of a child.

But please do not worry, even if the price is eternal demise, Ogier will spare no effort to fulfill his lord's commands.

May that day never come.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F.2@2, November, a major earthquake struck the Beren region.

The next day, two professors were ordered to head to the disaster area to search for the missing Mythag investigation team.

The team was last active along the Mare Internum coast, primarily tasked with exploring, excavating historical relics, and searching for possible leads related to the "D-phenomenon." 

On November 8, at the location where team members were reportedly last seen, Professor @2 discovered an unrecorded palace ruin and recovered a Mythag-standard silver key, numbered I-@2, but did not find any team members.

On November 9, two Silvers were unearthed at the site, which were later taken back to Londinium and sealed due to their historical value, to be Awakened on another day.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"If it's your first time carrying out an investigation mission, go find little Ogier to accompany you!" 

In response to the anxiety of new investigators, experienced seniors always offer this advice. Ogier's popularity among students is evident from this. 

Although his old-fashioned personality occasionally causes minor incidents, they support each other and lift one another up. Ogier always achieves the most harmonious rhythm with the investigators. In recent years, having Ogier accompany new investigators on their first missions has become a consensus among everyone at the school. Jokes like "Ogier prepares a cloak for female investigators" and "Ogier blushes when he sees legs" have also spread among the students. 

The title of "Death Knight" has gradually been forgotten, drowned in trust and warmth, leaving only a tiny thorn embedded in the young boy's heart.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Few people in school remember that the boy was once called the "Death Knight". 

Only at midnight does the scenery of that day transform into a nightmare, infiltrating the boy's dreams.

The dissoluted bodies invading the campus, the collapsed bell tower, the barely surviving "Keeper". 

"Don't cry, Ogier, it's not your fault..." 

The iron cavalry invading the home, the tilted palace, the black blood flowing from the princess's fingers.

"Don't sacrifice yourself for me, Ogier, you've done enough already..." 

The grains of memory entwined with pain wash over the boy's spirit.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
— How can this not be his fault? What he has done is far from enough.

With such extreme self-blame, Ogier executes his tasks at twice the frequency of other Awakeners, burying "Death" under universally praised "Virtue".

The excessive work and the words of gratitude from young Investigators seem to wash away the pain etched into the Soul.

Chronic ailments are pushed into the Shadows of the heart, emitting a rotting smell, secretly leading the knight towards the deep black mire.

"Sorry? Hello?"

Someone came to Ogier with a ray of sunshine, or a gust of wind.

"Senior said Ogier will join me and Ramona to carry out my initial Investigation task, right?"

He couldn't protect the princess for a second time, but Heaven gave him another chance to protect the "Keeper".

"My name is Ogier, and it is an honor to form a Contract with you. I will guard your Life with my Soul. Today's vow will be remembered forever."

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: My name is Ogier. As our contract stands, I pledge my knightly loyalty to you, to keep you safe, and to vanquish your foes. This solemn oath I take, and I'll never forget it.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Thank you for this honor, my lord. It means a great deal.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: I'm drawing closer to becoming a true knight!

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Bit by bit, I'm finding my rhythm with your commands!

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: I'll do my very best to live up to your hopes, my lord!

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I... I've just grown a bit stronger. I'm truly grateful!

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: I shall use this strength to keep you safe.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The Formless Spawns shall be at your command.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: My shield shall always shine for you, my lord.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Your trust is why I exist as a knight.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Good day, my lord. If you are going out to investigate, please let me come along as your guard.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Miss Ramona's swordsmanship is quite different from what I've learned. If my lord allows, I would dearly like to practice with her... Just for my own improvement, of course!

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: You ask why I don't play with the other children? It's hard to say... In my past life, I rarely had a chance to play. My only companion was the princess I served... Oh! To speak of another ruler before you, my lord, please forgive my slip.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Are you interested in the Seven Knightly Arts I've learned? That's wonderful! Ah... um... please forgive my rudeness earlier, my lord. What I meant was, if you'd like to practice mounted archery, I would be honored to be your sparring partner!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I am not a worthy knight. Whether it was the vile plague or the invading enemies, I failed to protect my former lord. Now, the trust you place in someone like me is a huge honor... I swear on my knightly honor and this small life that I will forever guard your path forward.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: My lord? Is there something wrong with my stance?

daily.title: Chat: About Knight
daily.content: The idea of a knight is formless, shaped by loyalty, bravery, and virtue. My weapon is the same, given form by the will to protect: a lance and shield.

daily.title: Chat: About Karen
daily.content: I've said no to the maid's banquet invitations a few times. She seemed a bit sad... But compared to just having fun, your safety, my master, is far more important!

daily.title: Chat: About Sorel
daily.content: The Madam in Red is unlike any lord I've ever served... No, it's not that I dislike her; I just... I just find it a bit hard to face her, sometimes...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: That dark presence reminds me of my Formless sword-shield... Oh! Please rest assured, my lord, my guardian sword will never harm you!

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Chemistry, Physics, Silver Core Applications... In this time, is it no longer needed to learn the Seven Knightly Arts? I understand. In that case, please arrange the right lessons for me, my lord!

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: The fairy tale books from this age are much more fun than the ones I read long ago! Oh, oh! My lord, please don't misunderstand! I'm too old for bedtime stories now!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I truly dislike my own failures... Oh! There's no need to comfort me! Those past hurts have become what drives me to grow. Haven't I already become your steadfast support?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: A lord is the very reason a knight exists, so please, feel free to give me your commands!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: The glory of victory is yours, my lord.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: I am so sorry, my lord, I failed to protect you...

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: This body shall be my lord's shield!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Oh, Formless Spawns, become a shield for my lord!
